text.card: A star about 48 parsecs away, 2.6 times the Sun's width, measured by Gaia.
text.introduction: Gaia's parallax, brightness and spectrum give it 2.6 solar radii and 1.59 solar masses (FLAME) and 6,249 K at its surface (GSP-Phot).

quotes.title: 38 Boötis
quotes.card: It has the traditional name Merga and the Bayer designation h Boötis; 38 Boötis is the star's Flamsteed designation.
quotes.introduction: This object is visible to the naked eye as a dim, yellow-white hued star with an apparent visual magnitude of 5.76.
